title: TFT connector identity unresolved
discrepancy: Historical docs specify 2x5; all actual source/BOM/fabrication evidence specifies 1x9 with a different order. Owner has only identified ILI9341 controller.
consequence: Wrong direct cable can apply power to signal pins.
correction: Correct docs (done); verify exact module labels/voltage/pitch/order and use a checked adapter if needed. HOLD display connection.
change_type: Documentation/cable; PCB rework only if an adapter cannot resolve fit
verification_method: DMM continuity each numbered carrier pad to net; compare actual module manufacturer pinout and mechanical dimensions
evidence: SCH PDF p5; BOM row15; FlyingProbe J_TFT_1..9; docs/05 corrected by A05

title: Unbuffered TFT LED load
discrepancy: R_TFT_LED is 0 ohm between PB0/USTM32.33 and J_TFT.8; no power driver/current limit exists on carrier. Module LED load is unknown.
consequence: Raw backlight LED current could exceed GPIO drive; no module-dependent safety assumption permitted.
correction: HOLD/open R_TFT_LED. Prove low-current logic enable input or design a rated driver with defined off state/current limit.
change_type: Population hold; external driver/cut-and-wire rework may be required; do not raise GPIO current
verification_method: Inspect module circuit; measure separately current-limited LED input. Confirm PB0 logic load within operating specification (absolute maximum is not a design target)
evidence: epro2 R_TFT_LED pads1/2; BOM row46; J_TFT.8; ST STM32F103C8 datasheet GPIO characteristics

title: UART cable instructions reversed
discrepancy: Actual J_UART.2=PA9/TX and .3=PA10/RX; prior docs had RX/TX reversed. Firmware is consistent with PCB.
consequence: Connecting output to output risks contention and failed communication.
correction: Correct docs (done); adapter RX to pin2, TX to pin3, GND to pin1; 3.3 V logic only, no power lead.
change_type: Documentation/cable; no PCB or firmware change
verification_method: Unpowered continuity J_UART.2 to USTM32.6 and .3 to .7; verify TX idle voltage before connecting
evidence: SCH PDF p5; FlyingProbe J_UART_2/3; bsp_uart.c:59-60; docs/05 corrected by A05

title: Buzzer BOM electrical type incompatible
discrepancy: Mallory PB-12N23MPW-12Q is a 9-15 V internally driven magnetic indicator; carrier feeds 5 V and firmware toggles a passive-transducer tone. No J_BUZZ exists.
consequence: Unreliable/absent sound; magnetic substitutions may also require flyback/drive review.
correction: HOLD BUZZER1; retain off for initial bring-up. Select a verified passive transducer and check drive, polarity and 7.6mm pitch before fitting.
change_type: BOM/population decision; possible driver rework for an inductive alternative; no firmware correction made
verification_method: Check actual part datasheet/label, impedance and compatible drive waveform; test separately with current limit
evidence: BOM row1; SCH PDF p5; bsp_timers.c:143; https://mspindy.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/LIT-Indicators-Electromagnetic.pdf p2

title: MCU module interchangeability unproven
discrepancy: Source specifies LCKFB-DKX-STM32F103C8T6 carrier module; STM32F103C8T6 names only the MCU, not the module wiring. PA13/14/PB2 are not carrier pads.
consequence: Wrong header/power mapping or USB pull-up may cause damage or constrain Flash CS; HSE/regulator assumptions can fail.
correction: HOLD module fitting until header continuity, dimensions, regulator, 8MHz HSE, SWD and USB-connected circuitry are checked. Do not connect module USB.
change_type: Owner inspection/module selection; adapter/rework if actual module differs
verification_method: Match 40-pad matrix including .18=+5V, .20/.38=3V3, .21=backup VBAT tied to3V3, .19/.39/.40=GND and inspect PA11/12 loads
evidence: BOM row51; USTM32 symbol/footprint; pin-net-matrix.csv; owner supplied MCU type only

consequence: Wrong voltage/polarity, missing cell protection, charger bypass or backfeed can invalidate SAFE/interlocks.
correction: Before power-on identify modules/cell and verify protected cell node, regulated5V, independent charger VBUS detect, current limit/UVLO and common GND. First tests use bench supply without cell/charger.
change_type: External wiring/component decision; no assumed carrier fix
verification_method: Inspect exact module documentation and wiring; unloaded/current-limited tests and power-state truth table before battery connection
evidence: SCH PDF p1/p5 J_PWR; owner: default charger/boost and unspecified single18650

title: 5-V analog outputs clamp into3V3 rail
discrepancy: AFE runs5V; BAT54S clamps feed3V3 through1k input resistors. Partial power or saturation may inject into an unpowered/non-sinking MCU rail.
consequence: Phantom power, ADC out-of-spec injection, rail rise and invalid residual permission.
correction: Do not power AFE without verified3V3 rail. Check start/stop/saturation clamp currents and rail voltage; stop on injection/rail rise.
change_type: Bench validation; hardware changes only if evidence requires
verification_method: Probe both rails and ADC pins during ramp/reset/load; measure current within ST injection limits
evidence: SCH PDF p2; BAT54S datasheet; ST STM32F103C8 ADC/injection limits

title: Debugger/UART may backfeed or alter ground
discrepancy: Adapter outputs can inject when target is off; shared PC ground does not assert external CHG_VBUS by itself.
consequence: Board may be partly powered while software/charger state appears absent.
correction: Use GND/common3V3 logic, no adapter5V/3V3 power lead; target-powered VTref sense only; disconnect driven debug signals for power-off tests.
verification_method: Measure target rails with target power off and each adapter attached; record whether any rail rises
evidence: J_UART actual pad map; ST GPIO injection limits; docs03 charger interlock

title: Relay state/coil release is commanded rather than sensed

consequence: A welded/reversed/misfitted relay can connect DUT to AFE despite software SAFE.
correction: Check loose relay pin map and unpowered NC continuity first; then operation/release and hardware USB inhibit with no DUT.
verification_method: Ohmmeter K1.13-.11 and .4-.6 closed at zero coil; .13-.9/.4-.8 open. Observe contact transition/coil at rated5V only after permits verified
evidence: SCH PDF p4; https://source.hongfa.com/Uploads/Product/PDF/HFD27_en.pdf p3

verification_method: Capture raw1X/HG waveforms and phasors per key; observe ADCrail approach and loaded phase
